Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue improve?
Choices:
A) The clarify, plan or implement workflows (`ai-clarify.yml`, plan or implement workflows, and their prompts)
B) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and the reviewer, aggregator and editor prompts)
C) The orchestrator (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`)
D) The AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`, the `ai-memory` branch)
E) Documentation only (README.md, `docs/`, `agents.d/` fragments)
F) Other: name the file, workflow or script in your `/answer` (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure: give the run ID, log excerpt or steps to reproduce (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cut cost or runtime (fewer tokens, fewer GitHub API calls, faster runs)
C) Make it more reliable (fewer flaky failures, better retries or self-healing)
D) Make it clearer for operators (better logs, Telegram alerts, docs)
E) Add a new feature: describe how it should behave
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A specific failure stops happening, checked by a new or updated contract test (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measurable metric improves: name it and the target (for example, runtime under N minutes)
C) A documented behaviour change that a reviewer can check from the PR diff
D) Other: describe the done condition in your `/answer`
